title: Tokyo 4-day food and anime trip
userRequest: I want to visit Tokyo for 4 days with a 7000 budget. I like anime, street food, bookstores, and relaxed neighborhoods.
finalAnswer: Suggested route: Day 1 Shinjuku and Harajuku, Day 2 Akihabara and Ueno, Day 3 Kichijoji and Nakano, Day 4 Asakusa and Tokyo Station. Keep one indoor option each day and reserve budget for transit, meals, and character goods.

messages.content: Please plan a 4-day Tokyo trip for anime and food.
I will organize the itinerary around anime districts, easy food stops, and slower neighborhood time.
Final plan includes Shinjuku, Harajuku, Akihabara, Ueno, Kichijoji, Nakano, Asakusa, and Tokyo Station.
